svg.title: Archive size versus compression time by effort
svg.desc: Silesia Windows application benchmark. ZIP and Zstandard cases are separate. The vertical time axis is logarithmic; lines connect each tool's explicit effort settings. Outlined points are measured non-dominated points, not confidence-backed winners. Rows list exact archive bytes and median seconds with observed min-max ranges.
svg.text: Smaller archive to the left; faster creation lower on each logarithmic time axis
Silesia subset | source 33f71ee38ee3 | 10 warm-cache runs per point
